title: data_items eval matches privacy-taxonomy labels to scanner labels
description: As a corpus reviewer, I want email_address and person_name annotations to score as label-correct against scanner user_email and first_name findings, so that label accuracy measures taxonomy alignment rather than string equality.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text:
Feature: data_items label aliases

  Scenario: Privacy taxonomy matches scanner enrichment labels
    Given a positive data_items case labeled email_address on app.ts line 10
    And a finding data_item:email with labels [user_email] on the same line
    When I score the eval cases
    Then the case is matched
    And labelsCorrect is true

  Scenario: person_name matches first_name
    Given a positive data_items case labeled person_name
    And a finding with labels [first_name] on overlapping lines
    When I score the eval cases
    Then labelsCorrect is true

  Scenario: components still require exact labels
    Given a components case labeled database
    And a finding with labels [sql]
    When I score the eval cases
    Then labelsCorrect is false
